comparison.limitation: Same seeds and policy implementations. State-responsive policies can choose different actual actions. Bundled growth, later-project workload, creative RA and deterministic IF changes; not a single-factor effect or a human-player/real-world probability.

denominators.abilities: All states reaching month 96; can include gameover. Fields doctoralCount/doctoralMeans retain historical names. Not all runs, not only successful doctorates.
denominators.papers: Ended at month 96 and canDefend(state) is true; actual fresh doctoral output, excludes later career anecdotes.
denominators.budgetBlocked: Incomplete, not an ending; included in policy-run counts but excluded from completed-ending counts.

growthRules.projectWorkMultiplier: 1 + 0.18 * min(4, projectId-1); first project and conference preparation unchanged
growthRules.creativeRA: enterprise = clamp((creativity-60)/7, 0.15, 3.5), then common gain scale and saturation
growthRules.legacy: Previously attained abilities, published papers and ended history are preserved. New gains use growthVersion 2. growthLegacyThrough records the transition month; no retrospective score reduction.

before.method: Five fixed policies through production simulation-worker; no ability, funds, or output injection. All policies intentionally continue into doctoral study and use managed finances to isolate student growth. Random means uniform legal weekly activities, feedback and affordable event options; default accepts proposals and first affordable event options. These are test policies, not human-player or real-world probabilities.
